g.text: PCB, enclosure and adjustable collar attachment
Prototype CAD · actual design geometry · dimensions in millimetres
Rigid housing 57.4 × 49.4 × 21 mm · outer holder 60.8 × 52.8 × 27.3 mm
Battery cradle · 40 × 32 mm PCB · antenna envelopes · gasket · lid
Two wrap straps · flat or V-groove pad · 120 / 220 mm strap options
KiCad r05m render · four package bodies use dimensional substitutes
Checked examples: flat 8 × 1, 25 × 3, 60 × 8 mm; round Ø4, Ø8, Ø16 mm. Grip, comfort and IP68 need physical qualification.
